exercises.name: Chin tucks
exercises.cue: Glide your chin straight back, as if making a double chin, then ease forward.
exercises.commonMistake: Tipping the head down instead of sliding it back.

exercises.name: Easy neck nods
exercises.cue: Tiny yes-nods from the crown — think 2 centimeters, not a big look-down.
exercises.commonMistake: Crunching through the whole neck.

exercises.name: Neck side stretch
exercises.cue: Ear toward shoulder, opposite hand resting in your lap. Breathe into the long side.
exercises.commonMistake: Hiking the opposite shoulder up toward the ear.

exercises.name: Slow neck turns
exercises.cue: Look over one shoulder as if checking a coworker, pause, then the other side.
exercises.commonMistake: Jerking or cranking to the end range.

exercises.name: Shoulder rolls
exercises.cue: Roll shoulders up, back, and down like you’re sliding off a too-tight jacket.
exercises.commonMistake: Only shrugging up, never finishing the down-and-back.

exercises.name: Shoulder blade squeezes
exercises.cue: Draw the blades toward each other and slightly down. Soften the ribs.
exercises.commonMistake: Flaring the ribs or puffing the chest.

exercises.name: Overhead reach
exercises.cue: Interlace fingers, turn palms up, and reach toward the ceiling without shrugging.
exercises.commonMistake: Cranking the low back instead of reaching long.

exercises.name: Desk push-away
exercises.cue: Hands on the desk, round the upper back as you push the desk away, then let the chest melt forward.
exercises.commonMistake: Locking the elbows hard or collapsing the neck.

exercises.name: Upper trap drop
exercises.cue: Hold the chair seat with one hand, gently tilt head the other way, and let that shoulder hang.
exercises.commonMistake: Yanking the head with the free hand.

exercises.name: Blade slides
exercises.cue: Arms by your sides, slide the shoulder blades down toward your back pockets, then release.
exercises.commonMistake: Pinching the neck instead of sliding the blades down.

exercises.name: Chest opener
exercises.cue: Clasp hands behind you (or grab the chair back) and open the collarbones to the room.
exercises.commonMistake: Craning the chin up or pinching the low back.

exercises.name: Seated cat-cow
exercises.cue: Hands on thighs: round the spine and look toward the belt, then lift the chest and gaze softly ahead.
exercises.commonMistake: Only moving the neck, not the ribcage.

exercises.name: Chair twists
exercises.cue: Sit tall, hand on the opposite chair back, and rotate from the ribs — not the neck.
exercises.commonMistake: Yanking with the arms or twisting through a slumped spine.

exercises.name: Stand-and-open
exercises.cue: Stand, hands on the low back or desk, and gently lift the chest as if looking over a fence.
exercises.commonMistake: Hinging only in the low back or throwing the head back.

exercises.name: Desk pec stretch
exercises.cue: Forearm along the desk edge, step the same-side foot back, and rotate the chest open.
exercises.commonMistake: Shrugging the stretching shoulder up by the ear.

exercises.name: Side body reach
exercises.cue: Sit tall, reach one arm overhead, and crescent over without collapsing the opposite hip.
exercises.commonMistake: Leaning forward instead of stacking long over the hip.

exercises.name: Wrist circles
exercises.cue: Elbows by your ribs, make slow circles with both fists, then switch directions.
exercises.commonMistake: Rushing or locking the shoulders up.

exercises.name: Palm-up stretch
exercises.cue: Arm forward, palm up; with the other hand, ease fingers toward the floor.
exercises.commonMistake: Bending the elbow or forcing a sharp angle.

exercises.name: Palm-down stretch
exercises.cue: Arm forward, palm down; gently draw the hand toward you until the top of the forearm wakes up.
exercises.commonMistake: Pressing into a painful pinch at the wrist crease.

exercises.name: Finger fans
exercises.cue: Spread the fingers wide, then make a soft fist. Repeat like a slow blink.
exercises.commonMistake: Clenching so hard the forearms cramp.

exercises.name: Prayer stretch
exercises.cue: Palms together at the chest, slowly lower the heels of the hands toward the navel.
exercises.commonMistake: Letting the heels of the hands peel apart.

exercises.name: Seated figure-four
exercises.cue: Ankle on the opposite knee, sit tall, and hinge a little forward from the hips.
exercises.commonMistake: Rounding the back instead of hinging, or forcing the knee down.

exercises.name: Chair-edge hip flexor
exercises.cue: Perch on the front of the chair, one foot back, tuck the tail slightly, and breathe.
exercises.commonMistake: Arching the low back instead of tucking gently.

exercises.name: Easy seated twist
exercises.cue: Inhale tall, exhale and rotate toward the chair back. Keep both sit bones heavy.
exercises.commonMistake: Twisting from a slumped seat or yanking the neck.

exercises.name: Seated glute squeezes
exercises.cue: Press the sit bones into the chair, squeeze, hold a beat, then fully let go.
exercises.commonMistake: Holding the breath or clenching the jaw.

exercises.name: Desk hip hinge
exercises.cue: Hands on the desk, send hips back, long spine, then stand by squeezing the glutes.
exercises.commonMistake: Rounding the back or locking the knees.

exercises.name: Seated marches
exercises.cue: Lift one knee, tap it down, switch. Keep the chest quiet and the belly soft.
exercises.commonMistake: Leaning back or gripping the chair for dear life.

exercises.name: Sit-to-stand
exercises.cue: Feet under knees, stand without using your hands if you can, then sit slowly.
exercises.commonMistake: Shooting the knees forward or collapsing the chest.

exercises.name: Desk calf raises
exercises.cue: Hold the desk lightly, rise onto the balls of the feet, then lower with control.
exercises.commonMistake: Bouncing or rolling onto the outer edges of the feet.

exercises.name: Ankle circles
exercises.cue: Hover one foot and draw slow circles. Switch direction, then switch feet.
exercises.commonMistake: Moving the whole leg instead of the ankle.

exercises.name: Box breathing
exercises.cue: Inhale 4, hold 4, exhale 4, hold 4. Soft belly, quiet shoulders.
exercises.commonMistake: Forcing a huge inhale or tensing the neck.

exercises.name: Double inhale
exercises.cue: Two sips of air in through the nose, then a long easy exhale through the mouth.
exercises.commonMistake: Rushing the exhale or lifting the shoulders on the sips.

programs.name: 2 min Desk Reset
programs.tagline: A tiny unstick. Still at your chair.

programs.name: 5 min Lunch Reset
programs.tagline: Shoulders, hips, and a real unstick.

programs.name: 10 min Busy-Day Circuit
programs.tagline: Stand, sit, breathe — then back to it.
